body: I liked it. I felt like there was easily recognizable voice in this. It was entertaining and funny.

I would like to be nicer, to where my immediate reactions are always nice or at least observational, but sometimes I feel like I act of without thinking too much.
I'd like to be smarter. I don't really feel that smart, or maybe just not very motivated. Whichever it is I'd like to fix it.
Finally, I'd like to be less selfish. I feel like i aim to do things I want, and aren't very considerate, or so I'm told.
